choices.label: Move both pointers one step at the same time from the same start.
choices.feedback: They remain together even in an acyclic list, so a meeting proves nothing.

choices.label: Advance one pointer by one link and another by two. A meeting proves a cycle; reaching a missing fast link proves termination.
